Finding the Largest of Three Numbers

Medium
Problem Statement
Read three integers and print the largest of the three using nested if-else statements.
Description
Read three integers a, b and c from input. Use nested if-else statements to compare the three values and determine the largest one, then print it.
Input Description
Three integers a, b and c separated by spaces.
Output Description
Print the largest of the three numbers.
Sample Input
4 9 7
Sample Output
9
